title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: Expiry Date of a Replacement Free Night Award
content:
**Clause.** A replacement's expiry date falls the replacement validity months of its award type after the reissue date, on the same day number, or on the last day of that month when it has no such day.

The terms of the clause are these, for replacements among the Free Night Awards:

- **The reissue date** is the date the replacement is deposited, which is its issue date.
- **The replacement validity months** are the figure set for the award type in the Free Night Awards reissue terms.
- **The month reached** is the calendar month that lies that number of months after the month of the reissue date.
- **The expiry date** is the day of the month reached that carries the reissue date's day number; when the month reached has no such day, it is the last day of the month reached.

### Worked dates (hypothetical replacement validity of 3 months)

| Reissue date | Month reached | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|
| 15 January 2027 | April 2027 | 15 April 2027 |
| 30 November 2026 | February 2027 | 28 February 2027, February 2027 having no 30th |
| 31 May 2027 | August 2027 | 31 August 2027 |

### Worked dates (hypothetical replacement validity of 6 months)

| Reissue date | Month reached | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|
| 31 October 2026 | April 2027 | 30 April 2027, April having no 31st |
| 6 October 2026 | April 2027 | 6 April 2027 |
